title: Chapter 62
text:
Han Xiao slowly outlined the process of Nosa and Lu Gao En's meeting.

First of all, Lu Gao En had only left an hour ago, which meant that he had only just received the information.

The two of them split up. Nosa came to assassinate him, and Lu Gao En chose to upload the information. Then, he found that all information about Zero was blocked, so he decided to leave the city.

Lu Gao En did not know that Han Xiao knew his identity, so he was not in a hurry to leave the city. Under such circumstances, he would choose the most natural direction to leave the city. The northwest sentry post was the closest to the slums, so it was most likely.

However, if Lu Gao En deliberately went the opposite way and chose the other two sentry posts that were further away, it was not impossible.

There were not enough clues.

"Hey, Han Xiao, we're here. Why are you looking for us?"

Li Ya Lin, Zhang Wei, and Lambert walked over. There was a yellow convertible sports car parked outside. This was Li Ya Lin's car. It was very fast, which was why they could arrive in time.

Han Xiao had already put on a mask when he killed Nosa.

"An emergency mission. The contact of the Germinal Organization has received important information and might have escaped from the three sentry posts. He might not have left the city yet."

Li Ya Lin immediately stopped smiling and said seriously, "Do you have what he looks like?"

Han Xiao's eyes lit up. He found three pieces of scrap paper on the ground and drew out Lu Gao En's features based on his memory. It was features, not looks, because he could not remember. He pulled the poor homeless man in front of him and yelled, "Look, doesn't he look like Lu Gao En?"

The homeless man trembled and said, "His eyes are deeper, his nose is a little crooked, and his hair is short …"

According to the homeless man's words, the portrait was quickly changed. This time, it should be 70% to 80% similar. Han Xiao marked the key features and distributed them to the three members of the team. "We'll split up and look for the officers at the sentry posts to find this person. Li Ya Lin and I will go together. We'll take her sports car to the furthest sentry post. You two can choose one."

Zhang Wei's face twitched. You're giving orders too naturally. Do you still have me in your eyes?

Even though Zhang Wei was cursing in his heart, he still looked at the bigger picture. He took the portrait and split up with Lambert, not bothering with small details as they tried to snatch the car in front of everyone.

Han Xiao jumped into the driver's seat of the yellow sports car. Li Ya Lin said unhappily, "Hey, this is my car, let me drive."

"You're driving too slow."

"How dare you doubt the driving skills of an agent!" Li Ya Lin was so angry that her eyebrows were raised, but she didn't want to waste any more time, so she had to hold it in. She sat in the passenger seat sullenly.

"Fasten your seatbelt," Han Xiao reminded.

Li Ya Lin glanced at Han Xiao and said with disdain, "Are you kidding me? I'm a martial artist, I'll be fine no matter how fast you drive."

"Just don't regret it."

Han Xiao nodded, put the car in gear and stepped on the accelerator.

Half an hour later.

The yellow sports car swung its tail fiercely, and the overheated tires left four black tracks on the ground. It steadily stopped at the entrance of the southernmost sentry post.

"Blergh —"

"Hey hey, aren't you a martial artist?"

"You … don't talk to me, blergh —"

Li Ya Lin's face turned green as she held onto the car door and vomited.

Crossing the city in half an hour, causing twenty-seven car accidents … or twenty-eight? Her head was spinning, and she couldn't count at all.

"Who, who taught you how to drive?"

Han Xiao was astonished. "Do you need someone to teach you how to drive?"

"Don't, don't you?"

"The first person to learn how to drive wasn't taught by someone else."

That makes sense! I'm actually speechless!

Li Ya Lin was dumbfounded. She wanted to say something, but the nausea surged up again. She turned around and vomited. She even vomited bile.

"Is there a need to? I just drove a little faster."

"A little faster? There's only one word that can describe your driving skills: brake failure! "

Li Ya Lin was like an angry little lion, baring its fangs and claws. Unfortunately, her pale face and pale lips made her look less threatening.

"Stop fooling around. Hurry up."

Li Ya Lin felt like she was floating and almost fell into the vomit. Han Xiao hurriedly held onto her and shook his head helplessly. He dragged Li Ya Lin forward like a dead pig.

When they arrived at the sentry post, the soldier on guard shouted, "Stop! Show me your ID!"

Han Xiao dug into his pocket and was stunned. He had forgotten to bring his Division 13 ID. He turned to look at Li Ya Lin and reached into her pocket.

Top … No.

Pants … No.

"Where's your ID?" Han Xiao asked.

Li Ya Lin was in a daze as she allowed Han Xiao to touch her sexy body.

I … I'm being taken advantage of?

"Ha, found it."

Han Xiao was overjoyed. He pulled out an ID from Li Ya Lin's hip pocket and showed it to the soldier on guard.

"Oh, you're a special agent. Please come in."

Han Xiao walked in a few steps and realized that Li Ya Lin was still standing there. She was biting her lips and staring at him.

Han Xiao was surprised. "What are you waiting for? Hurry up and come in."

Li Ya Lin took a deep breath and suppressed her anger. She said stiffly, "Give me back my ID."

"Why are you so troublesome?" Han Xiao was impatient. He turned around and put the ID back into Li Ya Lin's hip pocket.

Li Ya Lin's eyes widened.

I'm being taken advantage of again?

Han Xiao walked into the sentry post and found the officer in charge of surveillance. He showed Lu Gao En's portrait.

"Please wait a moment. The program is screening the portrait."

Li Ya Lin bit her lip and followed in. She felt that Han Xiao was touching her like a piece of pork. It made her feel very strange. She could not even feel angry. She just stared at Han Xiao angrily.

…

Lu Gao En followed the crowd in a low profile. The exit of the sentry post was right in front of them.

Lu Gao En belonged to an intelligence organization called the Wind Eye. He was an informant in the Western Capital. The Wind Eye organization was a subsidiary of the Germinal Organization. There were many organizations like this that did not have to use the Germinal Organization's name.

The structure of the Wind Eye organization was that there was only one person in charge of each city's intelligence network, who was called the contact person. The contact person would come in contact with the organization every once in a while. The contact person's subordinates were in charge of collecting intelligence and could only communicate with the contact person in writing.

Lu Gao En had also heard from his informant that a person who looked similar to Zero had appeared in District 7, but he did not know the exact location. After looking around, he realized that there was an area that seemed to be secretly guarded, and outsiders were not allowed to enter. Thus, he concluded that this area was Han Xiao's hiding place and was under the protection of Division 13.

The area was near the repair shop, and Feng Jun was secretly guarding it.

When Lu Gao En realized that no information about Zero could be transmitted through the network, he realized that hackers had blocked the city's network. To be safe, he immediately disconnected the network and destroyed his computer to prevent hackers from locating him. He immediately went to the sentry post and prepared to leave the city.

"With Norsa's ability, he should have gotten it by now."

At that moment, the iron wire gate in front of them slammed shut. The people waiting to leave the city were all blocked inside the sentry post.

"What's wrong?"

"Why can't we leave the city?"

The soldier shouted, "Orders from above. The city is temporarily sealed."

Everyone started to complain, but Lu Gao En felt that something was wrong.

"Why is the city being sealed? Did Norsa fail?"

Lu Gao En was shocked. This was important information that must be passed to the organization to increase Zero's threat level.

The soldier checked everyone's identities. Lu Gao En was very confident in his ability to hide. He had been in the West Capital for two to three years and had never exposed himself. It was impossible to find him.

"It's him!"

A loud shout rang out. Lu Gao En turned around and saw a group of soldiers aggressively walking towards him. Their target was him.

"Impossible!"

Lu Gao En was shocked. He wanted to retreat, but there were people all around him. Looking at the military facilities and soldiers everywhere, he felt a sense of despair. He was directly pressed to the ground by the soldiers and did not resist.

"We made it."

Han Xiao walked over and heaved a sigh of relief.

"You really caught up to me." Li Ya Lin was surprised.

Lu Gao En looked up and said, "How did you know it was me?"

Han Xiao was calm. This person was the contact of the Germinal Organization players in the West Capital. He had a deep impression of him.

Lu Gao En could not understand. He was about to bite the poison sac in his back teeth. He was loyal to the Germinal Organization. In order not to leak the information, he chose to end his life.

Han Xiao suddenly pulled out his pistol and shot Lu Gao En in the head. The bullet pierced through the back of his head, and blood and brain matter spurted out.

You have killed Lu Gao En Saiborn (LV12). You have received 3,500 EXP.

Han Xiao blew on the gun. Even if you want to die, you should give me some EXP.

"Why did you kill him?"

Li Ya Lin was surprised. In her opinion, he could have handed him over to the bureau for interrogation.

"He had poison sacs in his teeth, poison in his nails, and poison needles in his underwear. If he wanted to die, no one could stop him."

Han Xiao shook his head.

It was not important to him whether Lu Gao En was dead or alive. He knew what he needed to know.

"Looks like the plan needs to be carried out quickly." Han Xiao's eyes darkened.
